summary: Sprint 3 (Fixed Asset Register + HR/Payroll) — full backend + frontend regression against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 25/26 pytest cases pass. Verified: /api/assets returns 8 seeded assets across all 8 expected categories with book_value < cost (Land book == cost); /api/assets-stats/summary returns gross ~₹11.36 Cr, accumulated_dep ~₹2.54 Cr, net_block ~₹8.82 Cr with by_category / by_status counts; POST /api/assets auto-codes ASS/MPCA/2026-27/NNNNN, defaults life_years from category (Computer=3, Building=30, Land=0), and rejects salvage >= cost with 400; depreciation-schedule for a Building yields monthly = (cost-salvage)/360 and Land returns rows=[] + note; dispose flow requires reason (422/400), locks status=Disposed, computes gain_loss (in DB), and refuses duplicate dispose (400); /api/employees returns 7 seeded rows with Consultant Manish Gupta correctly flagged tds_applicable=True + pf_applicable=False; /api/employees-stats/summary returns count/active/by_type/monthly_gross_inr/annual_projected_inr where annual == 12×monthly; POST /api/employees rejects basic_pay_inr=0 and negative with 422 (Field(gt=0)); GET /api/payroll/registers returns 1 draft register for 2026-07 (~₹7.7L gross / ~₹7.15L net / 7 rows); per-row math verified: gross = Basic+HRA+Special+Conv, PF = 12% Basic when applicable, ESI = 0.75% Gross only if Gross ≤ ₹21K, PT = ₹200 fixed when Gross ≥ ₹15K, TDS = 10% Gross for consultant, Net = Gross - deductions; regeneration idempotent (same id returned); finalise flips Draft→Finalised, sets voucher_id, refuses second finalise (400) and refuses regeneration after finalise (400); voucher created via voucher_type=Payment · linked_module=payroll · linked_ref_id=reg.id · amount_inr==total_net_inr (verified by diffing /api/vouchers before/after). Sprint 1/2 regression endpoints (division-grants, vouchers, ledger?body_id=MPCA&fiscal_cycle=2026-27, finance/budget-vs-actual, purchase-orders, vendors-kyc/summary, shared/audit-log) all 200 OK. Frontend Playwright smoke against /asset-register + /payroll: 4 KPI tiles per view, 8 asset rows, filter chip 'depreciating' correctly excludes Land (8→7 rows), asset-drawer opens with dep-schedule + dispose-btn, new-asset dialog input-life placeholder is 'auto by category', payroll-page renders 2 tabs (Payroll Registers·1 · Employee Master·7) with correct KPI tile sets per tab, register-drawer renders full 12-column detail table with 8 payroll rows (7 original + 1 TEST_SPRINT3 employee added mid-test), reg-voucher badge shown for finalised register, finalise-btn correctly hidden post-finalise; new-employee dialog statutory hint switches correctly between 'PF 12% of Basic + ESI 0.75% if gross ≤ ₹21K + PT ₹200 (MP)' (Permanent) and 'Consultants: TDS 10% (u/s 194J), no PF/ESI/PT' (Consultant).

critical.issue: `gain_loss_on_disposal_inr` is computed and PERSISTED into Mongo on dispose, but is STRIPPED from every API response because the `Asset` pydantic model does not declare it as a field (AssetBase has ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and Asset inherits AssetBase). FastAPI's response_model=Asset serialisation drops the extra key. Confirmed via curl: disposed asset returns keys {status, disposal_date, disposal_amount_inr, disposal_reason, accumulated_depreciation_inr, book_value_inr} — but gain_loss is missing. Consequence: the /asset-register 'Disposal Record' block in AssetDrawer (which reads asset.gain_loss_on_disposal_inr, AssetRegister.jsx L231-232) will ALWAYS show ₹0 gain/loss regardless of the actual value. This is a visible business-logic bug for finance users. Fix: add `gain_loss_on_disposal_inr: Optional[float] = None` to the Asset model (routes/assets.py class Asset around L67).

minor.issue: Docstring/comment says 'AST/MPCA/2026-27/00001' but next_code('asset', ...) actually emits 'ASS/…' prefix (verified). Cosmetic — update the comment to match.

ui_bugs.issue: Persona name renders 'Shri Shri Mahanaryaman Scindia' — the honorific is concatenated twice (likely both the persona.name already contains 'Shri' and the AppLayout re-prefixes it). Cosmetic but visible on every page.

integration_issues.issue: AssetRegister.jsx reads asset.gain_loss_on_disposal_inr, but the backend response omits this key (see backend critical finding above). Post-disposal, the 'Gain/Loss' number will display as ₹0 for every disposed asset. Reproduction: dispose any asset with disposal_amount != book_value → drawer's disposal-block shows ₹0 instead of the real gain/loss (which IS correctly stored in Mongo).
affected_selectors: gain-loss-preview (dispose dialog is fine — computed client-side)

issues: Totals row in the 12-column payroll table uses `colSpan={4}` for the deductions cell (PF+ESI+PT+TDS collapsed into one cell showing ₹60,760). That's fine for at-a-glance, but a reviewer verifying whether PF or TDS reconcile per-column will need to sum by hand. Consider showing per-column sub-totals (Basic total, HRA total, PF total, TDS total) rather than collapsing everything.

The 'Life (years)' input placeholder says 'auto by category' but there's no live indicator of WHAT the auto life would be once a category is picked (e.g. Computer=3, Building=30). Small helper text under the field mirroring the DEFAULT_LIFE_YEARS[category] value would remove ambiguity.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/assets.py::dispose_asset writes gain_loss_on_disposal_inr via db.assets.update_one $set, but Asset pydantic model does not declare the field ⇒ FastAPI strips it on read. This is the classic 'silent field-drop' due to Config(extra='ignore') on the response model. Extend Asset to include disposal-side fields (disposal_date, disposal_amount_inr, disposal_reason are already declared; gain_loss_on_disposal_inr is not).

routes/hr_payroll.py::_compute_payroll_row PT logic: `PT_MP_SLAB_INR if gross >= 15000 else 0.0` uses a single flat slab. Real MP PT slabs (FY 25-26) are graduated: ₹0 up to ₹18,750/mo, ₹125/mo ₹18,751-25,000, ₹208 (₹212 in month of Feb) above ₹25,000 → total ₹2,500 annually. The current flat ₹200 for anyone above ₹15K is a simplification; document as an approximation or upgrade to a slab helper.

routes/hr_payroll.py::finalise_register: imports `from routes.vouchers import Voucher` INSIDE the function to avoid circular import. This works but couples routes/vouchers.py's Voucher class name — if Voucher is renamed or moved, the failure surfaces only at finalise time. Consider moving the Voucher class into core/models.py or a domain module referenced by both.

routes/hr_payroll.py::_compute_payroll_row: ESI boundary is `gross <= 21000` (inclusive). India ESI ceiling is ₹21,000 gross (excluded above), so `<=` is correct — but a comment stating 'inclusive per Employees State Insurance Act, Sec 2(9)' would help future auditors.

routes/assets.py::_compute_depreciation calculates months_used via `min(_months_between(purchase, end), total_months)` which is a signed month diff; a purchase_date IN THE FUTURE would give months_used=0 (correct, silently). But a purchase_date in an unparseable ISO format falls back to `purchase = as_on`, giving months_used = 0 (silent). Log a warning when purchase_date fails to parse — otherwise a data-quality issue hides.

routes/hr_payroll.py: /payroll/generate re-uses `existing['generated_at']` on regenerate (preserves first-cut timestamp — good) but does NOT preserve the `voucher_id` field when the existing register is Draft. That's fine (no voucher created yet in Draft), but code should assert existing['voucher_id'] is None on the regenerate path as a defence.

routes/hr_payroll.py::finalise_register writes {"status":"Finalised", …, "voucher_id": v.id}, but does not persist `linked_ref_code` back into the register. When someone looks at the register they see voucher_id (UUID) but not the friendly VCH/MPCA/2026-27/NNNNN code. Consider also persisting `voucher_no` on the register for legibility.

AssetRegister.jsx L149 util calc: `a.cost_inr ? (a.book_value_inr / a.cost_inr) * 100 : 100` yields 100% for zero-cost. A zero-cost asset is a data-quality issue; consider setting util to 0 (or hiding the bar) when cost is 0.

Payroll.jsx L115 KPI 'PF + ESI + PT' is the sum but excludes TDS. Copy is technically correct ('Statutory contributions'), but TDS-conscious auditors may misread. Sub-line already says 'Statutory contributions' which is fine, but the semantic split between TDS (Income Tax) and PF/ESI/PT (Employer statutory) could be reinforced with a tooltip.

rca of the issue: gain_loss_on_disposal_inr silent-drop RCA: routes/assets.py class Asset(AssetBase) inherits AssetBase which has ConfigDict(extra='ignore'). The dispose_asset endpoint (L245-257) writes gain_loss_on_disposal_inr into Mongo via $set, but the response is validated against response_model=Asset. Because gain_loss_on_disposal_inr is not a declared field on Asset (only disposal_date, disposal_amount_inr, disposal_reason are), FastAPI's model_validate call silently drops the key. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/assets/{id}/dispose -d '{"disposal_amount_inr": 5000, "disposal_reason": "obsolete"}'` → response has status=Disposed and book_value_inr, but NO gain_loss_on_disposal_inr; then GET /api/assets/{id} confirms the field is absent (though `db.assets.find_one({id})` in Mongo shows it IS persisted). Fix: add `gain_loss_on_disposal_inr: Optional[float] = None` on the Asset model. Alternative: change ConfigDict to extra='allow' (broader impact, not recommended).
